title: Expectation on $n+1$ bits as an iterated expectation
statement:
Let $h : \{0,1\}^{n+1} \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function on $n+1$ bits. Writing $(x', b) \in \{0,1\}^n \times \{0,1\}$ for the point of $\{0,1\}^{n+1}$ obtained by appending the bit $b$ to $x'$ as its last coordinate, the uniform expectation of $h$ can be computed by first averaging over the last bit and then over the remaining $n$ bits:
\[
  \E[h] \;=\; \E_{x' \in \{0,1\}^n}\Bigl[\tfrac12\bigl(h(x', 0) + h(x', 1)\bigr)\Bigr].
\]
hypotheses_covered: h is a Boolean function on n+1 bits
replaced:
For $h : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,(n+1) \to \bbr$,
\[
  \E[h] \;=\; \E_{x'}\Bigl[\tfrac12\bigl(h(\mathrm{snoc}(x',\mathit{false})) + h(\mathrm{snoc}(x',\mathit{true}))\bigr)\Bigr],
\]
the outer expectation being over $x' \in \mathrm{BoolCube}\,n$.
